findings.reachable_precondition: A serialized candidate/manifest/final is missing one mandatory nullable field while its actual bytes and links are otherwise valid. This is the explicitly approved writer/publisher edge fault model and needs no arbitrary public JSON input or real C/N. findings.actual_call_path: runPositivePilot -> actual writeEvidence/publishEvidence -> real mapper/fileFacts produce hashes for the actual changed bytes -> actual main/verifyPublishedRun -> actual legacy uses the same result. F10 retains `x !== null && x !== undefined` for manifest.listing_error, final.reporting_failure and final.manifest_error; artifactRowProblems likewise treats missing row.error as no error. These missing fields therefore pass as null, allowing normal accepted0/fault accepted1. F07 baseline===null only checks final.diagnostic_snapshot===null and skips candidate.receipt_summary, accumulator_summary, terminal_proof_observations and final.terminal_proof_observations. A well-published failed1 with those missing/wrong fields is still called reliable ordinary1.
findings.contract: Approved RESULT_CONTRACT_AND_CASE_MATRIX §1: all mandatory fields need own properties and undefined/missing differ from null; F07 requires candidate summaries/proof observations tied to the baseline, including explicit null in setup failure; F10 explicitly preserves the null-versus-missing distinction for report/evidence/manifest/publication. §3 requires all applicable fields' deletion/wrong-type/contradiction classes. SPEC requires the whole table, not only two local if fixes.
findings.impact: The sole validator still green-lights incomplete mandatory evidence and misclassifies some malformed failure evidence as reliable ordinary1. Actual main and legacy root-deletion condition consume it. This is evidence/qualification integrity, not a new resource-owner or kernel escape finding.
findings.minimal_fix: Add an explicit required-property/type pass covering the already published v2 nullable fields before mode or ordinary-failure decisions. Require explicit null for no-error F10 fields, and explicit row.error=null for error-free rows. In the baseline-null branch require all four published summary/observations fields to exist and be null; in the nonnull branch compare every mandatory summary without optional-skipping. Add the corresponding parameterized cases rather than claiming that the existing selected fields exhaust F01..F10. Keep valid ordinary failed1 and null snapshot controls; do not turn every setup failure into3 or invent a snapshot.
direct_counterexample_design: Use existing guarded normal StubSupervisor and realFsDeps/tamperWith; delete only final.reporting_failure or final.manifest_error before delegating REAL publishEvidence. No hash oracle changes: the publisher returns the actual serialized hash/size. Current checker returns reliable=true/accepted=true/exit0; actual main also returns0. Both must instead return unreliable3/no acceptance.

Normal realFsDeps: writeEvidence(manifest.json) copies data and deletes listing_error, or deletes artifacts[i].error for one error-free real artifact; delegate actual writer. Mapper and final links naturally match actual bytes, and current checker still accepts. Require3. Existing third-file EIO checks remain intact.

After real helper copy, inject an Error from createSupervisor so run has root and complete published ordinary failed1 but diagnosticSnapshot=null. At candidate writer delete or mistype receipt_summary/accumulator_summary/terminal_proof_observations; at final publisher delete or mistype terminal_proof_observations. Current baseline-null branch skips them and returns reliable=true/not-accepted/1. Require3 for mutations and preserve reliable ordinary1 for unchanged explicit-null controls. No actual process is launched.
